content: आथर्वण {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) [अथर्वणा मुनिना दृष्टः वेदः अण् आथर्वणः तमधीते वेत्ति वा अण् <ls>P. IV. 3. 133</ls>] Originating from, relating or belonging to, the Atharvaveda or the Atharvans; अग्नौ साक्षिण्याथर्वणेन विधिना <ls>Dk.</ls>; आथर्वणस्तीव्र इवाभिचारः <ls>Mv. 1. 62</ls>. .{@-णः@} .²1 A Brāhmaṇa knowing or studying the Atharvaveda. .²2 A descendant of Atharvan; इदं वै तन्मधु दध्यङ्ङार्थवणोऽश्विभ्यामुवाच <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 5. 16</ls>. .²3 A priest whose ritual is comprised in the Atharvaveda. .²4 The Atharvaveda itself (अथर्वणां समूहः). .²5 A house-priest. .{@-णम्@} .²1 A private room in which the sacrificer is informed of the happy event of the sacrifice by the officiating Brāhmaṇa. .²2 The black art, magic (जारणमारण). .{@-शिरस्@} {%n.%} <ab>N.</ab> of an Upaniṣad belonging to the Atharvaveda.
